title: Speaking — Buying local produce
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on buying local produce.

questions: Where do you usually spend time with friends?
How do you keep in touch with friends you rarely see?
What kinds of activities do you normally do together?
Do you prefer meeting one friend or a group?
Do you check where your food comes from?
What fresh food is easy to get near your home?

part2.topic: Describe a food producer or seller whose work you learned about.
points: where you met them or heard about their work
part2.closing: and explain why their work interested you.

questions: What can schools do to help students understand where food comes from?
How can local producers reach customers who have little time to shop?
How has everyday life connected with buying local produce changed for people of different ages?
